_comment: PNW mapd binary release pin. The ~20 MB pfeiferj `mapd` binary is intentionally NOT vendored in git (keeps clones and device updates small). system/mapd/installer.py downloads it at launch to the PERSISTENT /data/mapd/mapd (outside the git tree, survives auto-update git clean) and verifies `sha256` -- `install_path` below is NOT that live location, it's a legacy in-tree fallback only used off-device where /data isn't writable. To upgrade mapd: change version + url + sha256 + size here (get the sha with `sha256sum mapd`), nothing else -- BUT first check the device for a leftover /data/mapd/.override flag (`ssh comma@<ip> 'python3 -m openpilot.system.mapd.installer --check'`): while that flag exists, installer.py freezes the installed binary and silently ignores every pin bump (by design, for hand-deployed test builds -- see docs/GOMSGQ-SHADOW-FIX.md). Clear it with `rm /data/mapd/.override` on the device before expecting a version bump here to take effect. VERSION NOTE (mapd231pin2pnw, 2026-09-13): v2.3.1 is tag 7201c6b (released 2026-08-21). It links gomsgq v0.1.11 (= pfeiferj/gomsgq#2 'add additional safety for shadow subscribers', merged 2026-08-18; read from the binary's Go buildinfo), upstream's own fix for the shadow-reader `Invalid Msgq message size` panic (mapd#88). v2.3.0's gomsgq v0.1.10 predated that fix, so the earlier advice to build a patched mapd for it is obsolete. carState is still shadow-subscribed by default (the v1->v2 settings migration still hard-codes shadow_car_state=true), now on the fixed reader. Other v2.3.0->v2.3.1 changes: out-of-bounds map extraction near coordinate limits fixed (#126); mapdOut published from its own thread at a strict 20 Hz (#135; the earlier #128 attempt was reverted by #134); main-loop CPU/perf work (#132, #135); MapdExtendedOut gains loopRateAverage @4 / loopRateMin @5 (additive -- pnw cereal does not mirror them and older readers ignore them). MapdOut is unchanged. The release binary is the same byte size as v2.3.0 (21806000) but a different sha.
